scope: CPU-only regression/replay of the already calibrated PSI policy; no GPU, model load, server, requests, host changes or memory-pressure injection.
expected: moderate PSI warns and does not stop
severe PSI stops only after 15 consecutive samples
recorded Q91/Q93 traces warn as applicable and do not stop
